assumptions.choice: 250-bar rolling window evaluating handle lengths from 10 to 40 bars and cup segmentation into left rim (0-30%), bottom trough (30-70%), and right rim (70-100%).
assumptions.reason: The spec requires pattern formation of at least 1 year (~250 daily candles) with a U-shaped cup and handle consolidation. Parameterized geometric constraints allow deterministic pattern evaluation.

assumptions.choice: 1% (0.01) risk per trade relative to portfolio capital.
assumptions.reason: The spec mandates risk per trade not exceeding 1-2% of total capital; 1% is selected as the standard baseline.

assumptions.choice: Execute self.close() in next() when current bar closing price drops below handle_low.
assumptions.reason: The specification designates the lowest point of the handle as the default stop-loss level.
